text: Every great festival encodes an archetype of the soul's journey.
It seems. But it is not.
Εὖ ζῆν is the relationship I have with myself.
For me the easy thing is to walk the path of εὖ ζῆν.
Where I want to find my rights, I have probably lost justice.
I have not met a more luminous philosopher.
Abstaining from politics is itself a political stance.
Awakening is not an experience; it is a witness.
You play the role; you are not the role.
It was never the body that sensed.
Odysseus does not return to Ithaca. Odysseus wakes up in Ithaca.
Your sun was never in danger.
We're not two separate beings. We're one being.
I'm not a knower, I'm a lover of truth.
Love is the beginning of wisdom.
Philosophy is a path of love.
Ethics doesn't mean morality; it means habits of energy.
Ethics is an anagram of Ithaca.
Logos is not mind.
Every end of mine is my beginning.
Our centre is wisdom, but our boundaries must be red.
Ares is not the god of war; Ares is the god of peace.
Awakening that does not become life is incomplete awakening.
You are the gate that leads to your freedom.
Know that which knows.
Pain is the perfect motive to lead us to truth.
There is no death: only sleep, dream and awakening.
Nobody can schedule it: it is the Platonic 'suddenly'.
You are Pythagoras.
It is not revealed; we are revealed.
You will not become; you are.
Transformations always follow a crisis.
The first polity we must learn to govern is our soul.
Ancient is a qualitative, not a temporal, designation.
A No not accompanied by a Yes is lame.
They say love blinds; I think love un-blinds you.
What changes in the world? Nothing. In us? Everything.
Truth has no content.
Each of us is a seer.
We are the oracle of Delphi.
We are a lesche.
Peace and eros are two sides of the same coin.
In reality there are no others.
I call this the new spiritual cave.
Before you exist as Greek, you are.
There is one wonder-worker: the mind.
Even illusion is awakening that forgets itself.
Darkness, too, is light very much dimmed.
Philosophy begins with love and is completed for love.
Follow love, and love will set you free.
Disagreement is the beginning of agreement.
To love means: I am the ally of your freedom.
Philosophy and spirituality are not connected: they are identical.
